purpose: initial-position sensitivity only; no model selection or tuning

configuration.initial_position_accounting: preexisting at each month boundary; no artificial entry cost

download.source: Coinbase Exchange REST API product candles

data_audit.proxy_market: Coinbase BTC-USD spot; NOT Binance BTCUSDT perpetual
data_audit.gap_fill: prior close for OHLC and zero base/quote volume
data_audit.quote_volume: approximated as Coinbase base volume times OHLC mean
data_audit.taker_imbalance: unavailable; both taker-buy volumes set to 50% (imbalance zero)
data_audit.trades: unavailable; set to zero and not used by model features
data_audit.funding: unavailable/not applicable; zero rates on synthetic 8-hour schedule

limitations: BTC perpetual futures and their funding/taker fields did not exist for this model's market in 2016.
Coinbase BTC-USD spot prices and base volume replace Binance BTCUSDT perpetual inputs.
Quote volume is approximated; taker imbalance is neutral; funding rates are zero.
The model and normaliser were trained on the much later 2021-2026 regime.
Monthly resets are counterfactual diagnostics, not one continuous tradable strategy.
